app_settings_recording_email.name: app_settings_recording_email
app_settings_recording_email.value: key <> 'recording_email' or (value = lower(trim(value)) and length(value) <= 254 and value like '%_@_%._%')

assignments_bars_range.name: assignments_bars_range
assignments_bars_range.value: bar_from is null or (bar_from between 1 and 9999 and bar_to between bar_from and 9999)

assignments_description_length.name: assignments_description_length
assignments_description_length.value: description is null or length(trim(description)) between 1 and 1000

attendance_checkin_attended.name: attendance_checkin_attended
attendance_checkin_attended.value: method not in ('qr', 'code') or status in ('present', 'late')

dues_overrides_owed.name: dues_overrides_owed
dues_overrides_owed.value: typeof(owed_kurus) = 'integer' and ((kind = 'waiver' and owed_kurus = 0) or (kind = 'freeze' and owed_kurus between 1 and 1000000000))

dues_periods_reduced.name: dues_periods_reduced
dues_periods_reduced.value: reduced_amount_kurus is null or (typeof(reduced_amount_kurus) = 'integer' and reduced_amount_kurus between 1 and amount_kurus - 1)

fe_account.name: fe_account
fe_account.value: account in ('cash', 'bank') and (to_account is null or to_account in ('cash', 'bank'))

fe_transfer.name: fe_transfer
fe_transfer.value: (kind = 'transfer') = (to_account is not null) and (to_account is null or to_account <> account)

fe_dues.name: fe_dues
fe_dues.value: (category is 'dues') = (member_id is not null) and (category is 'dues') = (dues_period_id is not null) and (payment_group_id is null or category is 'dues')

fe_event.name: fe_event
fe_event.value: event_id is null or kind in ('income', 'expense')

fe_texts.name: fe_texts
fe_texts.value: (description is null or length(trim(description)) between 1 and 200) and (counterparty is null or length(trim(counterparty)) between 1 and 120)

fe_document.name: fe_document
fe_document.value: document_url is null or (document_url like 'https://%' and length(document_url) <= 2000)

fe_void_triple.name: fe_void_triple
fe_void_triple.value: (voided_at is null) = (voided_by is null) and (voided_at is null) = (void_reason is null)

fe_void_reason.name: fe_void_reason
fe_void_reason.value: void_reason is null or length(trim(void_reason)) between 5 and 200

fe_replaces_self.name: fe_replaces_self
fe_replaces_self.value: replaces_id is null or replaces_id <> id

member_dues_note_length.name: member_dues_note_length
member_dues_note_length.value: note is null or length(trim(note)) between 1 and 200

piece_links_voice_part_check.name: piece_links_voice_part_check
piece_links_voice_part_check.value: voice_part is null or voice_part in ('soprano', 'alto', 'tenor', 'bass')

piece_links_label_length.name: piece_links_label_length
piece_links_label_length.value: label is null or length(trim(label)) between 1 and 120

pieces_composer_length.name: pieces_composer_length
pieces_composer_length.value: composer is null or length(composer) between 1 and 120

pieces_arranger_length.name: pieces_arranger_length
pieces_arranger_length.value: arranger is null or length(arranger) between 1 and 120

pieces_language_length.name: pieces_language_length
pieces_language_length.value: language is null or length(language) between 1 and 40

pieces_voicing_length.name: pieces_voicing_length
pieces_voicing_length.value: voicing is null or length(voicing) between 1 and 20

pieces_duration_range.name: pieces_duration_range
pieces_duration_range.value: duration_sec is null or duration_sec between 1 and 5999

pieces_notes_length.name: pieces_notes_length
pieces_notes_length.value: notes is null or length(notes) between 1 and 1000

pieces_folder_url_check.name: pieces_folder_url_check
pieces_folder_url_check.value: drive_folder_url is null or (substr(drive_folder_url, 1, 8) = 'https://' and length(drive_folder_url) <= 2000)

rehearsals_open_idx.name: rehearsals_open_idx
rehearsals_open_idx.where: opened_at is not null and closed_at is null

rehearsals_closed_after_open.name: rehearsals_closed_after_open
rehearsals_closed_after_open.value: closed_at is null or (opened_at is not null and closed_at >= opened_at)

rehearsals_cancelled_not_open.name: rehearsals_cancelled_not_open
rehearsals_cancelled_not_open.value: cancelled_at is null or opened_at is null

sponsors_texts.name: sponsors_texts
sponsors_texts.value: (contact_name is null or length(trim(contact_name)) between 1 and 80) and (contact is null or length(trim(contact)) between 1 and 120) and (note is null or length(trim(note)) between 1 and 500)

submissions_method_check.name: submissions_method_check
submissions_method_check.value: method is null or method in ('self', 'manual')

submissions_feedback_meta.name: submissions_feedback_meta
submissions_feedback_meta.value: feedback is not null or (feedback_by is null and feedback_seen_at is null)

submissions_feedback_length.name: submissions_feedback_length
submissions_feedback_length.value: feedback is null or length(trim(feedback)) between 1 and 1000

submissions_not_empty.name: submissions_not_empty
submissions_not_empty.value: submitted_at is not null or feedback is not null

users_voice_part_check.name: users_voice_part_check
users_voice_part_check.value: voice_part is null or voice_part in ('soprano', 'alto', 'tenor', 'bass')

users_left_after_joined.name: users_left_after_joined
users_left_after_joined.value: left_at is null or left_at >= joined_at
